design.whole_content_hypothesis: After preparing and storing one fine plant-solid batch as a dried paste/cake, the next complete paragraph retrieves or applies that same preparation. Every material-taking clause must identify whether it uses the stored carrier, a portion drawn from it, or an explicitly introduced fresh material. This is one connected preparation/use account; repeated type names alone create no supplies.

conditional_incoming_state.execution_limit: These are consequences CONDITIONAL ON the earlier operations being executed with their prerequisites. design.new_consequence: A full written reuse of a portion must debit the same existingQ stock, while subsequent requirements of the complete stored batch still refer to its remainder. A fresh occurrence of a material noun cannot satisfy both requests. Similarly, a written POWDER-only input cannot draw directly on the unchanged paste carrier: an overt release/break-up constructor would have to account for the transition. An operation cannot restore coarse or uncomminuted plant material merely by renaming the patient.

rivals.contract: Unmarked compatible material references use the already stored batch; no stock creation. Actual withdrawal and use effects must be written and costed.
A new paragraph may begin a different preparation, but an actual new-input constructor and its complete initial quantity/state must be present. Physical paragraph order alone does not decide this.

The new paragraph may state properties or uses of a preparation kind without executing withdrawals. Assertions and hypothetical use must be marked by one reusable construction, not changed per occurrence.
